TEXT:
[FI] After struggling to leave Akiba, I received another 
text from Akagi.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Hey Kousaka, how has Sena been since? Anything 
about the guy I mentioned?

[FI] Rest easy, Akagi. Your sister's been talking nonstop 
about men earlier, but I didn't even catch a 
glimpse of the guy you're looking for.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Okay, Senpai. This is commonly referred to as the 
Maiden Road!
[FI] Yup, we're in Ikebukuro.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, check it out! There isn't a lot compared to 
Akiba, but there are many doujin shops here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You seem way more excited than you were in 
Akiba, though...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Fufufu... The stores around here are packed full of 
treasures that grab the hearts of maidens...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] If this were an RPG, this would be the city where 
all the magicians gather to buy magical items! 
Gotta save up your gold and buy in bulk, uhyuu!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If this is all magic, I only see black magic here...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] If Gokou-san was here she'd definitely say 
something like, "What an atrocious rotten smell... this 
must be the symposium of necromancy...!"

[FI] This girl's out of control, she's getting so worked up 
that she's being sarcastic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] H... Hey, I'm getting tired, how about you? We've 
been walking the entire time since Akiba. Wanna 
take a break?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I'm still good to go, but... we haven't had lunch yet, 
wanna get something to eat?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, sure! Let's take a break and eat.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Then, let's do that!

[FI] Phew, I managed to buy some time for her to 
calm down and make my life easier in the process. 
Or so I thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I recommend this place♪

SPEAKER: SPK_BUTLER
TEXT: [FI] Welcome back, M'lady, M'lord.
[FI] -It's a butler café!!

[FI] Yeah, should've noticed. There's that maid café in 
Akiba that Kirino and her group patronized, of 
course such a place would exist in Ikebukuro too...!

[FI] Dropping my shoulders while taking my seat, Sena 
made a meek expression and spoke.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Senpai, please be careful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Be careful of...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, right. There has to be some etiquette for a 
butler café. Stuff that I shouldn't do, anything like 
that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] No, nothing like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] There are many fantastic butlers here, so be 
careful not to fall in love with one.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Like heck I will!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh really? When we entered, you kept stealing 
glances at them...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I've never been to a place like this, I stared out of 
curiosity!

[FI] It's natural to be distracted by the sights of such 
an elaborate design. I can't even have that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Do you always have this irresistible urge of pairing 
people up whenever you see two or more guys 
together...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Not at all, it doesn't matter if the target is inorganic, 
represented by symbols, or even a general concept, 
I get off by equally pairing them up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That isn't something to say while puffing your chest 
out with pride.

[FI] Puffing out that massive chest while acting so 
smug. What are you saying with that triumphant 
look?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, the fact that I have to pair you with 
someone is your fault, not mine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You release an aura that's begging to be 
dominated so... I just can't take my eyes off you...

[FI] I don't understand the "begging to be dominated" 
part. But since it's scary to think that I might end 
up like Makabe-kun, I won't ask.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Just look at the customers around you, see? 
Everyone's already writing short stories in their 
head about you and a butler...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_A
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, isn't he giving a great [font_size=28]bottom[/font_size] aura? 
It's almost like a talent...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_B
TEXT:
[FI] A story about him coming here for the 
first time and a butler giving him a 
private [font_size=28]training[/font_size] might work...!

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_C
TEXT:
[FI] Sounds great!! His appearance is pretty normal for 
a bottom but, that makes it better...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=28]Th-This place is scary![/font_size] I feel like I should 
have never entered here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] H-Hey, you. Bring me something to eat so I can 
leave!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You can't say "you!" you have to say "Hey, boy." or 
something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh!? ...H-Hey, boy... Um, I leave it to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_BUTLER
TEXT: [FI] Certainly. Here is our menu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah...

[FI] When I leaned over to get the menu dropped by 
the butler, our hands touched-

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_A
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=28]The flag has arrived! Their first contact 
with each other-----!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_B
TEXT:
[FI] No doubt about it. That's the bottom's usual mating 
call...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_C
TEXT: [FI] Making an excuse this quickly... what a fearsome kid...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=26]W-W-Wait, trying to pick up a dropped 
menu, th-th-th-then their hands touched!!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=26]H-Hey, if you're doing this, then aren't you 
cheating on Onii-chan!?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You're making too much out of just fingers 
touching!

[FI] W-What's with this, putting Sena aside, why is 
everyone around us whispering!

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_A
TEXT:
[FI] Wow... He has a boyfriend, yet he's using such 
devious tactics...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_B
TEXT:
[FI] Touching each other, then connecting with their 
bodies...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_C
TEXT: [FI] I knew our eyes didn't deceive us!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What... should I do...!

[FI] -After that, I don't remember much about what 
happened.

[FI] I probably gave up resisting and just quietly ate a 
meal there.

[FI] There's also the feeling of being surrounded by a 
bunch of elder sisters going nuts over me and the 
butler.

[FI] I vaguely remember people asking for a photo of 
me with the butler, but my consciousness was 
already far gone at that point...

[FI] Anyway, the data collection, or rather the BL 
research session, was over.
[FI] ......Man, I'm exhausted.
